label: rare: 3rd copy output (recall_idx 2) in length-9 sequences
explanation: Very sparse reset-gate unit (0.03% of steps, max activation 0.010). Fires only in the copy phase, almost entirely at step t=11 of L=9 sequences, i.e. the step whose input is the 2nd original token fed back (prev2_tok = <DEL>) and which outputs original token 2; small spillover to recall_idx 1 and 3 and to L=8. Never fires in the original or delimiter phase. This position predicate covers ~89% of activation mass but only ~2% of such steps fire, so which specific steps fire depends on token identity in a way not captured: input tokens 3 and c (then o, m, v, e) and first tokens k/v/n/q/1 are over-represented, and larger activations are somewhat better covered by the position predicate. Token-set refinements raise precision only to ~15% at large recall cost (best F1 ~0.23), so the selection is not explained.
